move_pose.description: This surface drives one right arm, so the arguments are that arm's target with no targets wrapper and no arm choice.

position_mode.description: How the position is stated. hold_current keeps the measured position and takes no other position field. absolute also needs position_m. delta also needs translation_m and position_frame.

position_m.description: World position of the public TCP, in metres. Send with position_mode absolute. This is the field a pose copied from another tool fills.

translation_m.description: Translation to add, in metres, resolved once against the measured action-start pose. Send with position_mode delta.

position_frame.description: Frame the translation is expressed in. Send with position_mode delta. end_effector freezes the measured TCP frame once at action start.

orientation_mode.description: How the orientation is stated. hold_current keeps the measured orientation and takes no other orientation field. absolute_quaternion also needs orientation_xyzw. axis_angle_delta also needs rotation_axis, rotation_angle_deg and orientation_frame.

orientation_xyzw.description: World orientation of the public TCP as a quaternion in xyzw order. Send with orientation_mode absolute_quaternion.

rotation_axis.description: Axis of one in-place rotation. Send with orientation_mode axis_angle_delta.

rotation_angle_deg.description: Rotation about rotation_axis, in DEGREES. Send with orientation_mode axis_angle_delta. Do not convert to radians: this field is degrees and the receipt reports measured rotation separately.

orientation_frame.description: Frame the rotation is applied in. Send with orientation_mode axis_angle_delta.

interaction.description: Physical intent, never a controller name. Omitted means free_space.
